name: Sudden Death
description: One life, gentler stages. Pays x1.5.
_help: lives: every game starts with exactly this many, and Extra Life doesn't apply. payout: multiplies the stage tokens of a run you win (coins aren't multiplied). budgetScale: multiplies each stage's difficulty budget (1 = normal; below 1 = fewer and easier pieces, above 1 = more and harder ones).
